description: The file defines server-side request handling logic for a Remix-based web application. It manages incoming HTTP requests, differentiates between bot and browser requests, and streams server-rendered HTML responses. It also sets appropriate CORS headers and handles OPTIONS preflight requests.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function that processes incoming requests, sets CORS headers, handles OPTIONS method, and delegates to bot or browser request handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering and streaming response for requests identified as from bots.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering and streaming response for browser requests.
